key_insight: Genetic algorithms design interpretable spatial descriptors that balance local-response prediction error against the number of image measurements.
engineering_relevance: The framework helps tailor image-based materials predictors by identifying where spatial detail is needed and where regional summaries may suffice.
method: Benchmark regression models and inspect spatial attribution with SHAP maps.
Vary image patch size and compression to assess accuracy versus descriptor dimensionality.
Evolve Cartesian and polar spatial partitions with mean, minimum, and maximum pooling.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports evaluations on local spectra and hysteresis-loop prediction, but provides no numerical accuracy or compression results.
watch_item: Extension to molecules and solids requires domain-specific genetic algorithm rules that are not established here.
paper_title: Evolutionary Design of Interpretable Spatial Descriptors for Structure-Property Relationship Discovery
